articles.deck: Friends remember Edna Gilroy for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Stonebridge Trail Crew in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Bellwood Chapel
body: To the editor: I have lived on Whitney Court for 33 years, and I want to say what a difference the Bellwood Chapel has made.

body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Residents of Mill Hill said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
Public works estimates the work will take about 22 weeks once it starts in January.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. Councilmember Brian Feeney asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850.

articles.title: Letters: Vine Street Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the senior exercise class in the budget. Many of us on Vine Street use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Vine Street for 34 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
